name: QuickBooks Desktop (via Conductor)
desc: Sync invoices, bills, customers, vendors and payments with QuickBooks Desktop through the Conductor API bridge.

actions.name: upsert_customer
actions.description: Creates a customer in QuickBooks Desktop, or updates it if one with the same name already exists.

actions.name: upsert_vendor
actions.description: Creates a vendor in QuickBooks Desktop, or updates it if one with the same name already exists.

actions.name: create_invoice
actions.description: Creates an invoice for a customer in QuickBooks Desktop.

actions.name: create_bill
actions.description: Creates a vendor bill (accounts payable) in QuickBooks Desktop, expensed against one or more accounts.

actions.name: record_payment
actions.description: Records a customer payment against open invoices, or a vendor bill payment by check or credit card, in QuickBooks Desktop.

actions.name: query_transactions
actions.description: Searches across all transaction types in QuickBooks Desktop (invoices, bills, payments, and more) with date and type filters.

actions.name: list_items
actions.description: Lists Service and Non-Inventory items from QuickBooks Desktop, for finding the exact item name to use in Create Invoice's line items.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_or_updated_invoice
triggers.description: Fires when an invoice is created or updated (e.g. line items, balance, or payment status changed) in QuickBooks Desktop. One event per invoice change, not create-only.

triggers.name: new_payment
triggers.description: Fires once when a new customer payment is recorded (Accounts Receivable) in QuickBooks Desktop — a "Receive Payment" transaction, e.g. from the Record Payment action's Customer Payment mode. Create-only: editing an existing payment does not re-fire it. Vendor bill payments (Accounts Payable) do not fire this trigger.
